meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把内容变成支持备注和跳转的演示文稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常要把资料整理成可演示的幻灯片
copy.tagline_en: Turn your content into a presentation deck with speaker notes and branching.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn rough notes into a navigable slide deck for presenting.

howto.what: 当你要求做幻灯片或把网页转成演示时,Claude 会把内容做成一套 HyperFrames 幻灯片:能分页、可让部分内容逐条出现、支持热点按钮跳转和演讲者备注。交付的是可翻页运行的演示,不是渲染好的视频;没明说时他会先和你确认。
howto.when: 当你明确要“slideshow”,或提到 presentation、pitch deck 等近似词,或要求把现有页面转成演示时触发;若非明确要求,它会先问一句“要 HyperFrames slideshow 吗”再做。

say.text: 把我这份产品提案做成 8 页的 HyperFrames 演示。
say.note: 它会先确认,再生成可运行的演示页面。

say.text: 把公司主页转成可点击的幻灯片。
say.note: 会保留原页面视觉与交互进行转换。

say.text: 在第 4 页加一个“看数据来源”按钮,跳到附录页。
say.note: 会添加热点按钮和对应的分支路径。

howto.what_en: Given a slideshow/presentation or page-conversion request, Claude builds an interactive HyperFrames deck: discrete slides, fragment reveals, hotspots and speaker notes. Output is a runnable deck, not a rendered MP4; ambiguity is confirmed first.
howto.when_en: Triggered by explicit slideshow requests, or by related asks like presentation, deck or converting a page; when the request is adjacent, Claude confirms first.

say_en.text: Turn this product proposal into an 8-page HyperFrames presentation.
say_en.note: It confirms, then builds the deck.

say_en.text: Convert our homepage into clickable slides.
Add a see-data-source hotspot on page 4 that jumps to the appendix.
say_en.note: Adds a hotspot plus its branch.
